candidates.source_name: CERI – Centrálna evidencia regulovaných informácií (NBS Officially Appointed Mechanism)
candidates.why_relevant: Slovakia's statutory central storage mechanism for regulated information under the Transparency Directive (2004/109/EC), operated by Národná banka Slovenska. Every bank with securities admitted to the BCPB regulated market must file annual and half-yearly financial reports, inside information, voting-rights notifications, managers' transactions and debt-security holder information here. Historical archive back to June 2007. This is the legally mandated, complete feed for SK bank issuer disclosure — richer and more reliable than voluntary IR pages.
candidates.legal_status: official public register; documents are statutorily published
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scripted crawl of the database search UI (/search, /categories) filtered by issuer name/ICO and document category; no documented API or RSS was found, so pagination-based HTML scraping plus PDF/XHTML download is required. Snapshot quarterly around reporting deadlines (4 months after FY end for annual, 3 months for half-year).
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on the statutory term 'centrálna evidencia regulovaných informácií' + snowball from NBS supervision pages
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska centrálna evidencia regulovaných informácií emitent
Burza cenných papierov v Bratislave emitenti regulované informácie ročná finančná správa banka

candidates.source_name: CERI – Prospekty (approved prospectus sub-register)
candidates.why_relevant: Sub-section of CERI holding prospectuses approved by NBS under §120 Securities Act / Prospectus Regulation, including base prospectuses (základné prospekty) for bank bond and covered-bond programmes and registration documents. Prospectuses are the densest single disclosure for a bank: business description, risk factors, competitive positioning, card/payments and channel statistics, funding plans. Item-indexed URLs observed (e.g. ?item=1716) suggest a stable, enumerable identifier scheme.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate/iterate the ?item= identifier space or crawl the prospectus index; download PDFs and extract issuer, programme size, ISIN, date. Cross-reference with NBS covered-bond issuer list.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search on 'register prospektov / schválené prospekty' → landed on CERI prospectus item URLs
queries_used: NBS register prospektov schválené prospekty cenných papierov zoznam emitent

candidates.source_name: NBS – Emitenti cenných papierov (issuer obligations & downloadable filing forms)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative page defining WHAT issuers must file and in which template — 'Ročná správa', 'Polročná správa', 'Formulár zverejňovania informácií emitentmi dlhových cenných papierov' (XLS), voting-rights and home-Member-State notification forms. Gives the schema/vocabulary needed to parse CERI filings, and identifies the debt-securities-specific disclosure stream that covers bank bond issuers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off download of forms/templates to build a parsing schema; re-check annually for template changes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from CERI
queries_used: Burza cenných papierov v Bratislave emitenti regulované informácie ročná finančná správa banka

candidates.source_name: NBS – ESEF guidance for Slovak issuers (deferral, XHTML/iXBRL obligation)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines the machine-readability boundary for the SK cell: Slovakia used the one-year ESEF deferral, so mandatory XHTML (and iXBRL tagging of IFRS consolidated statements) applies from FY2021 reports filed in 2022 onward; PDF-only annual financial reports are explicitly treated as non-compliance with §34 Securities Act. This tells the collector that SK bank annual financial reports from 2022 onwards should be structured-parseable, while earlier years are PDF.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read once to set extraction strategy; pair with ceri.nbs.sk/notice_4 (ESEF filing notice) and ceri.nbs.sk/manuals.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language ESEF query
queries_used: ESEF XBRL ročná finančná správa Slovensko emitent jednotný európsky elektronický formát NBS

candidates.source_name: Burza cenných papierov v Bratislave (BCPB / BSSE) – exchange website
candidates.why_relevant: Sole regulated-market operator in Slovakia and the venue where bank bonds, covered bonds (hypotekárne záložné listy / kryté dlhopisy) and MREL instruments are admitted. Publishes issuer lists, listed-security detail pages, price lists (kurzový lístok), SAX index, exchange rules and issuer announcements. It is the counterpart feed to CERI: admission/delisting events and issuer notices routed via BISE.
candidates.access_status: public_free (website); some market-data products are paid
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the issuer and listed-securities sections plus the price list; note the site has both a modern /bcpb/ CMS and legacy .aspx pages, so the crawler must handle both URL generations. Fetch from an EU-egress IP and with a browser-like UA.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from NBS 'Burza cenných papierov – základné informácie'
queries_used: Burza cenných papierov v Bratislave bsse.sk kurzový lístok emitenti zoznam cenných papierov dlhopisy
bsse.sk "informačné povinnosti emitentov" OR "Emitenti" burza Bratislava stránka
candidates.observed_blocker: Direct fetch of https://www.bsse.sk/bcpb/en/provision-of-information/ returned connect ECONNREFUSED 195.80.190.46:443 — hypothesis: US-egress/bot filtering or TLS-handshake refusal, NOT a dead site (search engines index the same URLs and other bsse.sk PDFs resolve). UNVERIFIED; retry from EU IP.

candidates.source_name: BCPB – Informačné povinnosti emitenta (issuer information duties)
candidates.why_relevant: Specifies what each issuer must disclose depending on the market tier of admission (kótovaný hlavný trh vs regulovaný voľný trh) and the accepted submission channels (BISE, e-mail ok@bsse.sk, post). Needed to know which bank issuers have which disclosure obligations and therefore what the collector should expect to exist.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch plus the exchange rules PDFs (BP_RVT, BP_KT) for the disclosure matrix; re-check on rulebook amendments.
candidates.discovered_via_method: site-scoped search on the Slovak statutory phrase 'informačné povinnosti emitentov'
queries_used: bsse.sk "informačné povinnosti emitentov" OR "Emitenti" burza Bratislava stránka

candidates.source_name: BISE – Burzový informačný systém emitentov (BSSE issuer information system)
candidates.why_relevant: The electronic channel through which BCPB-listed issuers (including banks) transmit disclosures; BSSE then redistributes them to domestic and international press agencies and the public. Identifying BISE matters because it explains the propagation path of a Slovak bank announcement (issuer → BISE → agencies/media), i.e. where the same item can be picked up downstream if the primary page is blocked.
candidates.access_status: submission side restricted to issuers; published output is public
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not attempt the issuer-side login. Collect the public output on bsse.sk announcement pages and, as a redundancy, the agency wires that receive the BISE feed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from BCPB issuer-duties page
queries_used: bsse.sk "informačné povinnosti emitentov" OR "Emitenti" burza Bratislava stránka

candidates.source_name: BCPB – Jednotný elektronický formát vykazovania (ESEF) page
candidates.why_relevant: Exchange-side ESEF instructions for listed issuers; complements the NBS ESEF notice and helps confirm which SK issuers file iXBRL-tagged annual financial reports vs plain XHTML (tagging is only mandatory for IFRS consolidated statements, which is decisive for bank groups).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch; monitor annually.
candidates.discovered_via_method: site-scoped snowball on bsse.sk
queries_used: bsse.sk "informačné povinnosti emitentov" OR "Emitenti" burza Bratislava stránka

candidates.source_name: Centrálny depozitár cenných papierov SR, a.s. (CDCP SR) – national numbering agency & issue register
candidates.why_relevant: Sole Slovak CSD and the national numbering agency assigning ISIN/CFI/FISN under ISO 6166. Every dematerialised bank bond or covered-bond issue must have an ISIN assigned and be registered with CDCP before admission. CDCP is therefore the earliest-visible signal of a new bank funding instrument — often before the prospectus surfaces on CERI — and the authoritative issuer↔ISIN mapping key that links CERI filings, BCPB listings and ECB/market data.
candidates.access_status: public_free for register/ISIN lookup; some services fee-based for issuers
candidates.legal_status: official register operated by a licensed CSD
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the ISIN/issue lists and the emitenti sections; maintain a local ISIN→issuer→instrument-type table used as the join key across the whole cell.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on the official CSD name; snowball into its issuer/ISIN sections
queries_used: Centrálny depozitár cenných papierov SR cdcp.sk register emisií ISIN

candidates.source_name: NBS – Zoznam bánk emitujúcich kryté dlhopisy a správcov programu krytých dlhopisov
candidates.why_relevant: Definitive, regulator-maintained roster of exactly which Slovak banks run a covered-bond programme, plus the cover-pool administrator (správca programu krytých dlhopisov) and deputy. This is the cleanest way to scope the universe of SK bank regulated issuers in this cell — it converts 'which banks disclose under this channel' from guesswork into an authoritative list.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly fetch and diff; use as the seed list of issuers for CERI/BCPB/CDCP crawls.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on 'kryté dlhopisy / register krytých dlhopisov'
queries_used: NBS register krytých dlhopisov emitenti krytých dlhopisov zoznam banka Slovensko

candidates.source_name: NBS – Kryté dlhopisy: legislation & Vestník NBS (opatrenia o registri krytých dlhopisov)
candidates.why_relevant: Sets the legal content of the covered-bond register that each issuing bank must maintain (cover-pool composition, valuations, programme rights/obligations) — e.g. Opatrenie NBS č. 13/2018 as amended by č. 5/2023. Knowing the mandated register schema tells the analyst exactly which cover-pool data fields banks must be able to report, and hence what to expect in their investor/cover-pool reporting.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off download of the opatrenia + monitor the NBS Vestník RSS/listing for amendments.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from NBS covered-bond hub
queries_used: NBS register krytých dlhopisov emitenti krytých dlhopisov zoznam banka Slovensko

candidates.source_name: NBS – Zoznam schválených kótovacích prospektov cenných papierov
candidates.why_relevant: NBS's index of approved listing particulars/prospectuses — an event log of which issuer got which instrument approved and when. Useful as a low-volume trigger feed: a new approval for a bank signals an imminent bond/covered-bond issue and a fresh, information-dense prospectus landing in CERI.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly fetch and diff against prior snapshot; each new row triggers a CERI /prospekty pull.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search for the NBS prospectus list
queries_used: NBS register prospektov schválené prospekty cenných papierov zoznam emitent

candidates.source_name: NBS – Burza cenných papierov / trh cenných papierov supervision pages
candidates.why_relevant: Regulator's description of the exchange, its market segments and the free public information BCPB must provide (15-minute delayed online trading data, issuer and member lists, statistics, publications). Confirms the free-vs-paid boundary of BCPB data and provides authoritative pointers into the exchange for a crawler.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read; annual re-check.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query snowball

candidates.source_name: Register účtovných závierok (RÚZ) – registeruz.sk
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry of Finance / DataCentrum public register of financial statements and annual reports (výročné správy) for all Slovak accounting entities from 2013 onward, including banks and non-listed payment/e-money institutions. It is the fallback and cross-check for the regulated-issuer channel: entities that do NOT trigger Transparency-Directive disclosure still appear here, and filings are keyed by IČO, giving a clean entity join.
candidates.legal_status: official public register; statutorily published documents
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the documented Open API (JSON, versioned via X-API-Version header, supports a 'changed-from' incremental parameter) for continuous incremental harvesting by IČO — far preferable to scraping. Seed with IČOs of SK banks and payment institutions.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for the statutory register, then targeted query for its API

candidates.source_name: ESAP – European Single Access Point (ESMA)
candidates.why_relevant: Forward-looking structural change to exactly this cell: from 10 July 2026 collection bodies (i.e. NBS/CERI as the SK OAM) begin feeding Transparency Directive, Prospectus Regulation and Short Selling Regulation data to ESAP, with public access by July 2027, in machine-readable form and free of charge. Once live, ESAP becomes a single cross-border, structured substitute for scraping CERI and 26 other national mechanisms — the collection architecture for this cell should be designed to migrate to it.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor ESMA ESAP pages now for API/technical specifications; plan a migration of the SK regulated-disclosure feed from CERI scraping to ESAP structured retrieval in 2027.

negative_findings.description: Searched CERI's own documentation pages (/docs, /categories, /manuals) for an API, RSS feed, bulk export or open-data dump of regulated information. None is documented: the site advertises only a database search UI with print/download of individual documents.
negative_findings.result_summary: No API/RSS/bulk-download endpoint found for ceri.nbs.sk. Collection will require HTML crawling of the search interface plus per-document file retrieval.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets the engineering cost and fragility of the single most important source in this cell, and strengthens the case for planning a migration to ESAP structured access from 2027.

negative_findings.description: Every direct WebFetch attempt against www.bsse.sk returned 'connect ECONNREFUSED 195.80.190.46:443'. Search engines index the same URLs and PDFs hosted on bsse.sk appear in results, so the site is very likely live.
negative_findings.result_summary: bsse.sk not fetchable from this environment; treated as bot-defended/geo-restricted, NOT dead. Content for BCPB candidates was reconstructed from search-result metadata and NBS descriptions rather than direct reading.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The exchange is a core node of this cell. If the block is IP-based, the deterministic verification pass and the eventual collector must run from an EU egress or via a headless browser; otherwise the whole BCPB branch will be falsely marked dead.

negative_findings.description: Searched in both Slovak and English for a public, per-bank MREL/resolution disclosure register for Slovakia (e.g. a Rada pre riešenie krízových situácií / resolution council publication of bank-level MREL targets or eligible-liability issuance). No such Slovak national register surfaced within this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: No SK-specific public MREL disclosure store identified; MREL-eligible senior instruments appear only indirectly via issuer prospectuses and CERI filings.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MREL issuance is one of the stated triggers for this cell's regulated-disclosure flow; without a dedicated register, MREL intelligence must be reconstructed from prospectuses, Pillar 3 reports and parent-group disclosures, which is slower and less complete.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language searching for foreign-venue listings of Slovak bank instruments (e.g. covered bonds or senior notes listed in Luxembourg or Vienna rather than on BCPB) produced no clear local-language term or index. Slovak terminology exists for the instruments (kryté dlhopisy, hypotekárne záložné listy) but not for a 'foreign listing venue' concept that search engines resolve.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not establish, in this run, whether and where SK bank benchmark covered bonds are listed outside BCPB.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If benchmark issues are listed abroad, the SK regulated-disclosure channel (CERI/BCPB) would be incomplete for the largest transactions, and the collection plan would need a foreign-OAM branch.

negative_findings.description: CERI documentation states that filings submitted before 31 July 2011 may require in-person consultation at NBS headquarters by appointment, even though electronic storage nominally begins 1 June 2007.
negative_findings.result_summary: Pre-2011 regulated information is only partially available online.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Caps the depth of any automated long-run time series for SK bank disclosure at roughly 2011 without manual archival work.

coverage_gaps.description: Only the three largest banks (Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka) were mapped to issuer-side disclosure hubs. Smaller regulated issuers likely in scope — Prima banka, 365.bank/Poštová banka, ČSOB SK, UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia (SK branch), Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka — were not individually verified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the NBS 'Zoznam bánk emitujúcich kryté dlhopisy' as the authoritative issuer roster, then run one targeted sk-language pass per bank on the pattern '<bank> prospekt kryté dlhopisy' and '<bank> emisné podmienky dlhopisy'.

coverage_gaps.description: No commercial aggregator of Slovak regulated disclosure (e.g. financial data vendors, Slovak business-intelligence services such as FinStat or Cribis that resell RÚZ/ORSR data) was assessed in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the SK commercial aggregator layer separately; it can offer normalized, API-accessible versions of RÚZ/ORSR data that would cut engineering cost, subject to licence terms.

coverage_gaps.description: The CERI search interface's URL/parameter structure, pagination behaviour, and whether issuer filings can be filtered by IČO or LEI were not inspected — only the static documentation pages were read.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-driven exploration of ceri.nbs.sk search to capture the query-string schema and confirm whether results are server-rendered (scrapable) or JS/XHR-driven (needs the underlying JSON endpoint, which may be a de-facto API even if undocumented).

coverage_gaps.description: Pillar 3 / prudential disclosure (zverejňovanie informácií podľa CRR, 'informácie o banke' under NBS opatrenie) was not scouted, although it is the disclosure stream carrying capital, liquidity and operational-risk detail for SK banks and is legally distinct from Transparency-Directive filings.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass on 'zverejňovanie informácií bankou podľa opatrenia NBS', 'Pillar 3 správa banka Slovensko', and each bank's 'Informácie o banke' page.

coverage_gaps.description: Foreign listing venues and foreign OAMs potentially holding disclosure for Slovak bank instruments were not covered (see negative finding on foreign listings).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query issuer prospectuses for the 'admission to trading' clause to identify the actual venue(s), then add the corresponding OAM to the collection map.

brief: Slovakia's regulated-issuer disclosure channel is unusually clean and legally concentrated: NBS operates CERI (ceri.nbs.sk) as the national officially appointed mechanism holding all Transparency-Directive filings since June 2007 plus a distinct approved-prospectus sub-register, while BCPB (bsse.sk) is the sole regulated market where bank bonds and covered bonds are admitted and routes issuer notices through its BISE system; CDCP SR supplies the ISIN/issue registration that joins the two, and NBS's covered-bond issuer list authoritatively scopes which banks are in this channel at all. Machine-readability improves sharply from FY2021 reports onward because Slovakia used the one-year ESEF deferral and NBS now treats PDF-only annual financial reports as non-compliant, but neither CERI nor BCPB documents an API or bulk export, so near-term collection means HTML crawling — with registeruz.sk's documented incremental JSON Open API as the one genuinely programmable source in the cell. Two operational cautions: every direct fetch of bsse.sk was refused at the TCP level from this environment (treated as bot/geo defence, not a dead site, and requiring EU-egress re-verification), and ESAP begins collecting SK Transparency and Prospectus data on 10 July 2026 with public access by July 2027, so any scraper built here should be designed for migration rather than permanence.
